content.text: {"baseline":[{"year":1992,"status":"RANGES","ranges":[{"start":"1992-05-12","end":"1992-09-20"}],"cite":["C2:L34-L50","C3:L20-L28","C3:L40-L44"]},{"year":1993,"status":"RANGES","ranges":[{"start":"1993-05-12","end":"1993-09-20"}],"cite":["C2:L34-L50","C3:L20-L28","C3:L40-L44"]},{"year":1994,"status":"RANGES","ranges":[{"start":"1994-05-12","end":"1994-09-20"}],"cite":["C2:L34-L50","C3:L20-L28","C3:L40-L44"]},{"year":1995,"status":"RANGES","ranges":[{"start":"1995-05-12","end":"1995-09-20"}],"cite":["C2:L34-L50","C3:L20-L28","C3:L40-L44"]},{"year":1996,"status":"RANGES","ranges":[{"start":"1996-05-12","end":"1996-09-20"}],"cite":["C2:L34-L50","C3:L20-L28","C3:L40-L44"]},{"year":1997,"status":"RANGES","ranges":[{"start":"1997-05-12","end":"1997-09-20"}],"cite":["C2:L34-L50","C3:L20-L28","C3:L40-L44"]},{"year":1998,"status":"RANGES","ranges":[{"start":"1998-05-12","end":"1998-09-20"}],"cite":["C2:L34-L50","C3:L20-L28","C3:L40-L44"]},{"year":1999,"status":"RANGES","ranges":[{"start":"1999-05-12","end":"1999-09-20"}],"cite":["C2:L34-L50","C3:L20-L28","C3:L40-L44"]},{"year":2000,"status":"RANGES","ranges":[{"start":"2000-05-12","end":"2000-09-20"}],"cite":["C2:L34-L50","C3:L20-L28","C3:L40-L44"]},{"year":2001,"status":"RANGES","ranges":[{"start":"2001-05-12","end":"2001-09-20"}],"cite":["C2:L34-L50","C3:L20-L28","C3:L40-L44"]},{"year":2002,"status":"RANGES","ranges":[{"start":"2002-05-12","end":"2002-09-20"}],"cite":["C2:L34-L50","C3:L20-L28","C3:L40-L44"]}],"target":{"status":"RANGES","ranges":[{"start":"2019-06-01","end":"2019-08-31"}],"cite":["C2:L56-L61","C4:L35-L39"]},"cells":{"status":"ALL_SEA_CELLS","missing_boxes":[],"missing_rule":"","cite":["C2:L59","C3:L35","C3:L40","C3:L44-L47","C4:L37-L39"]},"exceptions":{"status":"NONE","items":[]},"summary":"Baseline SST for 12 May to 20 Sep of each year 1992-2002 is loaded, and the code builds the smoothed 90th-percentile threshold from it for the sea cells (finite on every target day). The 92 target days are compared with that threshold, hot runs are found and gaps joined in mhw_array, and the result is written as the mask. The baseline window covers day-of-year 133-264, which exactly spans the pools and 31-day smoothing needed for the target days (153-244), so no baseline day, target day or sea cell is dropped."}
